endorsements.label: CVE-2017-7435
endorsements.description: In libzypp before 20170803 it was possible to add unsigned YUM repositories without warning to the user that could lead to man in the middle or malicious servers to inject malicious RPM packages into a users system.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.0, 8.1)

endorsements.name: Ludwig Nussel
endorsements.label: CVE-2018-12473
endorsements.description: A path traversal traversal vulnerability in obs-service-tar_scm of Open Build Service allows remote attackers to cause access files not in the current build. On the server itself this is prevented by confining the worker via KVM. Affected releases are openSUSE Open Build Service: versions prior to 70d1aa4cc4d7b940180553a63805c22fc62e2cf0.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: LOW (CVSS 3.0, 3.1)

endorsements.label: CVE-2021-46705
endorsements.description: A Insecure Temporary File vulnerability in grub-once of grub2 in SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15 SP4, openSUSE Factory allows local attackers to truncate arbitrary files. This issue affects: SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15 SP4 grub2 versions prior to 2.06-150400.7.1. SUSE openSUSE Factory grub2 versions prior to 2.06-18.1.
